name: hgi_dfe4b_ctrl
structural_change: Actual negative ctrl3b CTS replaced with eight registered radix16 carry-save multiplication stages and three five-stage 12-bit carry pipelines. Bounded32rowqueue, exact400fullwidth/rebase wrap/order/bubble bench plus observed arithmetic mutants; logical9529Q. CLOSED lane2 untouched.

slot_change_request.reason: Front has no accepted hard slot; replace324um core with8 SRAM lane leaves and standalone controller, preserve4XS leaves. Exact outlines await synth gate.

job.purpose: Actual controller4b indexed arithmetic pipeline, bounded queue32, unchanged source-row B2 mapping and epoch protocol. No positive native VM claim; actual clock/pin evidence required before route.
